articles.title: One Fuel, Two Engines: MIT's Tiny Spacecraft Trick Could Send Satellites to Mars!
articles.summary: Imagine a car that runs on both gas and electricity from the same tank. MIT engineers built a tiny spacecraft engine that does just that—using one fuel for both fast zooming and slow, careful moves. This could let small satellites explore Mars and beyond.

articles.title: Scientists Mapped Every Brain Cell in a Fruit Fly—And Found a Big Surprise!
articles.summary: For the first time, scientists have a complete wiring diagram of a fruit fly's brain and nerve cord. The map shows that many actions, like walking, are controlled by local circuits in the body, not just the brain. This changes how we think brains and bodies work together.

articles.title: AI Fails a Classic Brain Game That Kids Ace—Here's Why
articles.summary: You know that game where you say the color of a word, not read it? AI chatbots like ChatGPT are terrible at it when the list gets long. They can't ignore the word and just see the color, revealing a big difference between human and machine attention.
